rows.label: ATTITUDE

rows.label: ABSOLUTE

rows.label: GRASP

rows.label: DREAMING
rows.clue: Imaginative thoughts indulged in while awake

rows.label: POINT
rows.clue: A geometric element that has position but no extension

rows.label: LAYOUT
rows.clue: A plan or design of something that is laid out

rows.label: ITCHING
rows.clue: An irritating cutaneous sensation that produces a desire to scratch

rows.label: CASH COW
rows.clue: A project that generates a continuous flow of money

rows.label: PARAGON
rows.clue: An ideal instance

rows.label: MAKE
rows.clue: A recognizable kind

rows.label: SCHEME
rows.clue: An elaborate and systematic plan of action

rows.label: SCIENCE
rows.clue: A particular branch of scientific knowledge

rows.label: AUDITION
rows.clue: The ability to hear

rows.label: HEED

rows.label: IMPRINT
rows.clue: A distinctive influence

rows.label: DULLNESS
rows.clue: The quality of being slow to understand

rows.label: FIGMENT
rows.clue: A contrived or fantastic idea

rows.label: COMPLEX
rows.clue: A conceptual whole made up of complicated and related parts

rows.label: OPTICS

rows.label: SYNTAX
rows.clue: The grammatical arrangement of words in sentences

rows.label: BENT

rows.label: QUEST

rows.label: IDEAL

rows.label: INQUIRY

rows.label: WARMTH

rows.label: MATTER
rows.clue: A vaguely specified concern

rows.label: BIAS
rows.clue: A partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation

rows.label: TALENT

rows.label: VISION

rows.label: TEMPLATE

rows.label: DEVICES

rows.label: BONUS
rows.clue: Anything that tends to arouse

rows.label: EXIT POLL

rows.label: VALUE

rows.label: INTEREST

rows.label: INTRIGUE

rows.label: RELIANCE

rows.label: ESTIMATE
rows.clue: An approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth

rows.label: HUMANISM

rows.label: GEOLOGY
rows.clue: A science that deals with the history of the earth as recorded in rocks

rows.label: STRAND

rows.label: GENUS

rows.label: TENDENCY

rows.label: VIEW

rows.label: LITERACY
rows.clue: The ability to read and write

rows.label: AGE NORM
rows.clue: The average age at which particular performances are expected to appear

rows.label: JUDGING
rows.clue: The cognitive process of reaching a decision or drawing conclusions

rows.label: RUB
rows.clue: An unforeseen obstacle

rows.label: LEAST
rows.clue: Something that is of no importance

rows.label: LATTICE
rows.clue: An arrangement of points or particles or objects in a regular periodic pattern in 2 or 3 dimensions

rows.label: CUNNING
rows.clue: Shrewdness as demonstrated by being skilled in deception

rows.label: ISSUE
rows.clue: An important question that is in dispute and must be settled

rows.label: HANG
rows.clue: A special way of doing something

rows.label: GEOMETRY
rows.clue: The pure mathematics of points and lines and curves and surfaces

rows.label: CANDOR
rows.clue: Ability to make judgments free from discrimination or dishonesty

rows.label: SPECIFIC
rows.clue: A fact about some part (as opposed to general)

rows.label: REVIEW
rows.clue: A new appraisal or evaluation

rows.label: PURE TONE
rows.clue: A steady sound without overtones

rows.label: OBSTACLE
rows.clue: Something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted

rows.label: DOUBT
rows.clue: The state of being unsure of something

rows.label: ETHIC
rows.clue: The principles of right and wrong that are accepted by an individual or a social group

rows.label: TRUTH
rows.clue: A fact that has been verified

rows.label: ANATOMY
rows.clue: The branch of morphology that deals with the structure of animals

rows.label: PRICING
rows.clue: The evaluation of something in terms of its price

rows.label: INKLING
rows.clue: A slight suggestion or vague understanding

rows.label: VALUES
rows.clue: Beliefs of a person or social group in which they have an emotional investment (either for or against something)

rows.label: SENSE
rows.clue: A general conscious awareness

rows.label: GENETICS
rows.clue: The branch of biology that studies heredity and variation in organisms

rows.label: SLANT
rows.clue: A biased way of looking at or presenting something

rows.label: LEXICON
rows.clue: A language user's knowledge of words

rows.label: REAL LIFE
rows.clue: The practical world as opposed to the academic world

rows.label: FEATURE
rows.clue: A prominent attribute or aspect of something

rows.label: PILLAR
rows.clue: A fundamental principle or practice

rows.label: DREAM
rows.clue: A series of mental images and emotions occurring during sleep

rows.label: EYE CANDY
rows.clue: Visual images that are pleasing to see but are intellectually undemanding

rows.label: OPERAND
rows.clue: A quantity upon which a mathematical operation is performed

rows.label: PEDAGOGY
rows.clue: The principles and methods of instruction

rows.label: OUTLOOK
rows.clue: A habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations

rows.label: IDIOCY
rows.clue: Extreme mental retardation

rows.label: BIOLOGY
rows.clue: The science that studies living organisms

rows.label: GIVEN
rows.clue: An assumption that is taken for granted

rows.label: MEMORY
rows.clue: Something that is remembered

rows.label: INTEGRAL
rows.clue: The result of a mathematical integration

rows.label: SAVOR
rows.clue: The taste experience when a savoury condiment is taken into the mouth

rows.label: SCENT
rows.clue: A distinctive odor that is pleasant

rows.label: FIGURING
rows.clue: Problem solving that involves numbers or quantities

rows.label: MAGIC
rows.clue: Any art that invokes supernatural powers

rows.label: FRACTAL
rows.clue: (mathematics) a geometric pattern that is repeated at every scale and so cannot be represented by classical geometry

rows.label: DYNAMICS
rows.clue: The branch of mechanics concerned with the forces that cause motions of bodies

rows.label: PROWESS
rows.clue: A superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation

rows.label: REGIMEN
rows.clue: (medicine) a systematic plan for therapy (often including diet)

rows.clue: A number or letter indicating quality (especially of a student's performance)
